domain: One complete four-dimensional causal diamond, iid uniform in physical four-volume conditional on fixed N. Full strict order; no coordinates, extra labels, total Poisson count, external time or additional geometry passed to the decision.

goals.directions: both separately; unconditional on issuing a singleton

matching.matching: uniform perfect matching independent of the observed order, implemented by an independent random permutation of all indices

necessary_check: Event Hellinger affinity at alpha=0.05 and power=0.80 with the same point affinity as v0.1. Round outward. No optimum claim.
scientific_design: Deterministic planning using published model moments. Thresholds selected using theoretical planning, not empirical target clouds. Numerical reference computations are audit checks, not the source of the certificate.
engineering_checks: After the local freeze generate exactly one new full-budget cloud for each of the two models and each procedure, four total. Use separate SHA-256 namespaced PCG64 streams for coordinates, anonymisation and pairing. No reseeding, tuning, replacing or enlarging the four cases; no empirical power estimate. Independently recount full orders or queried pairs and check decision against integer thresholds. Record hashes of simulated coordinates and, for the full counter, oriented packed rows; matching store pairing hash. Full orders can be regenerated.
